description: Daily data of a dishwasher: consumption (DailyWaterCons, DailyEnergyCons, DailyDetergentCons, DailyRinseAidCons), counters (C0xx codes) and the hygiene protocol (one entry per wash cycle, with its program code). Hobart refreshes this only after the machine is powered off or shortly before midnight, so it describes the last completed day of use, not right now.

serial.description: Machine serial number, as returned by hobart_list_machines.

name: hobart_get_machine_data
title: Hobart machine daily data
